items.name: BuildError
items.summary: An error that occurred during the construction of an Aho-Corasick automaton.

items.name: MatchError
items.summary: An error that occurred during an Aho-Corasick search.

methods.name: invalid_input_anchored
methods.summary: Create a new "invalid anchored search" error. This occurs when the caller requests an anchored search but where anchored searches aren't supported.

methods.name: invalid_input_unanchored
methods.summary: Create a new "invalid unanchored search" error. This occurs when the caller requests an unanchored search but where unanchored searches aren't supported.

methods.name: kind
methods.summary: Returns a reference to the underlying error kind.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new error value with the given kind.

methods.name: unsupported_empty
methods.summary: Create a new "unsupported empty pattern" error. This occurs when the caller requests a search for which matching an automaton that contains an empty pattern string is not supported.

methods.name: unsupported_overlapping
methods.summary: Create a new "unsupported overlapping search" error. This occurs when the caller requests an overlapping search while using an Aho-Corasick automaton with a match kind other than [`MatchKind::Standard`].

methods.name: unsupported_stream
methods.summary: Create a new "unsupported stream search" error. This occurs when the caller requests a stream search while using an Aho-Corasick automaton with a match kind other than [`MatchKind::Standard`].
